acceptedAnswer.text: City Dweller, LLC specializes in a range of floor transition repairs, including re-securing loose strips, replacing damaged sections, and installing new transitions where flooring materials have been changed. We work with various materials such as wood, laminate, tile, and vinyl, ensuring a seamless and durable fix that matches your existing decor and flooring types.
acceptedAnswer.description: City Dweller, LLC handles re-securing, replacing, and installing new floor transitions for various flooring materials like wood, laminate, and tile.
